claim_narrative: LockBit 4.0 ransomware encrypted 140 production servers causing 36 hours of outage. CISO reported the incident within 14 hours. MFA was enforced across all VPN/IAM endpoints, and all critical patches were current. Insured claims $850,000 for forensics and restoration.

Threat actor breached legacy Windows Server via exposed RDP port where Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) had been disabled by IT admins for 4 months, exploiting a critical CVSS 9.8 vulnerability unpatched for 65 days. Insured claims $1,400,000.

Accounts Payable wired $420,000 to a spoofed supplier IBAN following a spear-phishing invoice manipulation. Out-of-band callback verification was documented, and notification occurred within 24 hours. Subject to Social Engineering Sublimit ($250,000 cap, $25,000 deductible).

Category 3 Named Storm caused surface flash flooding in Zone A warehouse, resulting in 96 hours of business interruption and $1,850,000 in verified physical damage. Flood sublimit is $2,500,000 with a $250,000 Named Storm deductible.

peril_category: Gradual Roof Membrane Rot & Rust Seepage
claim_narrative: Adjuster inspection determined water damage to inventory resulted from 5 years of gradual corrosion, fungal rot, and deferred maintenance on a 26-year-old roof membrane with no storm event.

Vessel reefer container compressor failed mid-voyage for 14 consecutive hours, confirmed by continuous IoT data-logger telemetry, spoiling $950,000 of pre-chilled monoclonal antibodies. Subject to $50,000 per-conveyance deductible.
Plan member incurred $475,000 in eligible inpatient oncology surgery and FDA-approved immunotherapy with approved Prior Authorization. Specific Stop-Loss deductible is $75,000.

peril_category: Highway Jackknife Collision with Disabled ELD
